Keeping cut flowers at home

Simple care notes

  • Use a clean vase and refresh the water regularly.
  • Remove leaves that would sit below the water line.
  • Keep the arrangement away from direct afternoon sun and strong heat.
  • Dispose of tired stems and refresh the remaining arrangement as needed.

A small arrangement can change shape

Flowers open at different speeds. Repositioning a few stems can keep a small vase balanced as larger blooms open. These general household notes do not guarantee a fixed lifespan.

Ask about the varieties in your own arrangement when collecting it. Keep any flower-care product away from food, children and animals and follow its labelled instructions.
